content: Blood pressure and volume should be routinely monitored in patients. Laboratory tests should be performed at intervals based on the stage of chronic kidney disease (CKD): every 6 to 12 months for patients with G3 CKD, every 3 to 5 months for those with G4 CKD, and every 1 to 3 months for individuals with G5 CKD. These intervals should be adjusted according to the severity of symptoms and any changes in therapy.
